entry.title: [mahdi_mohammadi61] This new strategy effectively puts the chaos in Iran at the service of…
entry.summary:
Source: @mahdi_mohammadi61

This new strategy effectively puts the chaos in Iran at the service of producing violence and steering Iranian society toward regime overthrow, and it presupposes political goals such as the necessity of forcing Iran to make concessions. In this new American planning, however, the U.S. was not alone. The complementary aspects of this strategy, which notably employed more security-oriented language, were revealed by the Zionist regime and the Saudis. Mohammed bin Salman, in an unprecedented strategic-security blunder, openly stated that the war should be taken inside Iran and that one should "strike at the head of the snake," thereby exposing a very important project that should have, by all accounts, proceeded covertly. At the same time, Israeli sources, citing the regime's national security team, unveiled the strategy of "killing with a thousand cuts," or what Naftali Bennett called "attacking the cat's head rather than its paws." Bennett's strategy is the one dubbed the "Octopus Plan" in the media. The totality of these cases indicated that the strategic decision-making that took place in the Trump administration was, above all, based on an Israeli perspective on the Iran file, which seeks to move away from soft approaches and mobilize American power and that of other actors to deliver successive blows to Iran. At that same time, important information was released showing that the U.S. was essentially beginning a process whose outcome would be the handover of the management of the Iran file to Israel. The beginning of a new era of assassinations, at the forefront of which was the martyrdom of Haj Qasem Soleimani with the facilitation of Aman (Israel's military intelligence agency) in Baghdad, followed by the assassination attempt on Martyr Fakhrizadeh in Tehran, indicated that at that juncture, the strategic and even operational management of the Iran file was almost entirely in Israel's hands, and the Americans had little room for independent action.
📘 From the book "Sarāb-e Sāyehā" (Mirage of Shadows)
✍🏻 By Mehdi Mohammadi
